# Light Upon Light

> Light Upon Light is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to advocacy, accessibility, education, and equality for differently-abled people.

Light Upon Light serves the Greater Seattle Area (Everett and Redmond, Washington). EIN 99-2690459. Contact: lightuponlight1408@gmail.com | 206-766-0884. Program space (by appointment): 16305 NE 87th St, Suite 110, Redmond, WA 98052.

Prefer the Markdown links below for agent-friendly summaries. HTML pages are listed under Optional for human browsing.

## Pages

- [Home](https://thelightuponlight.org/index.md): Mission overview, pillars, programs summary, and ways to help
- [About](https://thelightuponlight.org/about.md): Organization story, leadership, who we serve, and FAQ
- [Programs](https://thelightuponlight.org/programs.md): All six programs with schedules, locations, and purposes
- [Volunteer](https://thelightuponlight.org/volunteer.md): How to volunteer and get involved
- [Donate](https://thelightuponlight.org/donate.md): Donation options and impact
- [Contact](https://thelightuponlight.org/contact.md): Contact methods and appointment booking
- [Blog](https://thelightuponlight.org/blog.md): Stories and updates from Light Upon Light

## Programs

- [Enlighten](https://thelightuponlight.org/programs.md): In-school education for empathy and inclusion
- [Big Light, Little Light](https://thelightuponlight.org/programs.md): Mentorship between differently-abled mentors and mentees
- [Light Desserts](https://thelightuponlight.org/programs.md): Accessible baking and life skills
- [Signs of Our Light](https://thelightuponlight.org/programs.md): Lived-experience accessibility assessments
- [Sending Light Abroad](https://thelightuponlight.org/programs.md): Refurbished mobility aids for underserved communities
- [Meet Our Light](https://thelightuponlight.org/programs.md): Personalized in-person donation pickup
